rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something dangerous or involving risk.

example.english: Walking this mountain path at night is risky.
example.traditional: 夜晚行呢條山路好危險。
example.jyutping: je6 maan5 haang4 ne1 tiu4 saan1 lou6 hou2 ngai4 him2

rows.note: Use this when you want to stress exposure to possible loss or harm rather than immediate physical danger.

example.english: Putting all my savings into one stock is risky.
example.traditional: 將全部積蓄投落一隻股票係有風險嘅。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 cyun4 bou6 zik1 cuk1 tau4 lok6 jat1 zek3 gu2 piu3 hai6 jau5 fung1 him2 ge3
